the initial stage: In the initial stage of the project, we spent most of our time collecting ideas and planning.
在計畫的初期階段，我們大部分時間都在蒐集想法和做規劃。
an initial reaction: My initial reaction to the news was shock, but after a day I calmly accepted the change.
我聽到消息時最初的反應是震驚，但一天後我就平靜地接受了這個改變。
the initial investment: Solar panels are expensive at first, but you can get back the initial investment through lower electricity bills.
太陽能板一開始很貴，但你可以透過較低的電費把初始投資賺回來。
initial results: The initial results of the test look promising, but scientists need more time to be sure the medicine works.
測試的初步結果看起來很有希望，但科學家需要更多時間來確定這種藥有效。
initially: Initially, I thought the new teacher was too strict, but later she became my favorite teacher.
起初，我覺得新老師太嚴格，但後來她成了我最喜歡的老師。
take the initiative: Instead of waiting for others to act, Amy took the initiative and organized a beach clean-up for her class.
艾美沒有等別人行動，而是採取主動，為班上籌辦了一場淨灘活動。
on one's own initiative: No one asked him to, but Ken cleaned the whole classroom on his own initiative after the party.
沒有人要求他，但派對結束後阿肯主動地把整間教室打掃乾淨。
a new initiative: The city launched a new initiative to plant ten thousand trees to reduce summer heat.
該市推出一項新倡議，要種一萬棵樹來降低夏季的高溫。
use one's initiative: The manager told the new workers to use their initiative and solve small problems without always asking for help.
經理要新員工發揮主動性，自行解決小問題，不要事事都求助。
a peace initiative: The two countries finally signed a peace initiative to end the long war along their border.
兩國終於簽署了一項和平倡議，以結束邊境上的長期戰爭。
the inner city: Many poor families in the inner city cannot afford good housing, so the government is building cheaper apartments.
市中心貧民區的許多貧窮家庭負擔不起好的住房，所以政府正在興建較便宜的公寓。
one's inner circle: Only the president's inner circle knew about the plan before it was announced to the public.
在計畫對大眾公布之前，只有總統的核心圈子知情。
inner peace: Many people practice yoga or meditation to find inner peace after a busy and stressful day.
許多人在忙碌又充滿壓力的一天後，會練瑜伽或冥想來尋找內心的平靜。
one's inner self: Writing in a diary every night helps me understand my inner self and what I really want in life.
每晚寫日記幫助我了解內在的自我，以及我真正想要的人生。
inner strength: After losing her job, she showed great inner strength and started her own small business.
失業之後，她展現了強大的內在力量，自己創業開了一家小公司。
the inner workings: The tour let visitors see the inner workings of the factory, from raw materials to finished products.
這趟參觀讓遊客看到工廠的內部運作，從原料到成品都一覽無遺。
be innocent of the crime: The DNA evidence proved that he was innocent of the crime, so he was finally released from prison.
DNA證據證明他無罪，所以他終於被釋放出獄。
an innocent bystander: During the robbery, an innocent bystander was hurt while simply waiting for a bus outside the bank.
搶案發生時，一名無辜的旁觀者只是在銀行外等公車就受傷了。
an innocent question: I meant no harm; it was just an innocent question, so I was surprised when he got so angry.
我沒有惡意，那只是個無心的問題，所以他那麼生氣讓我很意外。
innocent fun: The water fight at the camp was just innocent fun, and nobody got hurt or upset.
營隊裡的打水仗只是無傷大雅的樂趣，沒有人受傷或不高興。
be found innocent: After a long trial, the woman was found innocent and walked out of the courtroom with her family.
經過漫長的審判，這名婦人被判無罪，和家人一起走出了法庭。
innocent until proven guilty: In a fair legal system, everyone is innocent until proven guilty, even if the newspapers say otherwise.
在公平的司法制度中，每個人在未經證實有罪前都視為無罪，即使報紙說法不同也一樣。
an innovative approach: Our teacher used an innovative approach to grammar by turning each lesson into a group game.
我們老師用了一種創新的做法教文法，把每堂課都變成分組遊戲。
innovative technology: The hospital uses innovative technology that allows doctors to perform surgery with the help of robots.
這家醫院使用創新科技，讓醫生能在機器人的協助下進行手術。
highly innovative: The young designer's highly innovative ideas, like chairs made from recycled bottles, won her many awards.
這位年輕設計師極具創新性的點子，例如用回收瓶做成的椅子，為她贏得了許多獎項。
an insane idea: Swimming across the lake at midnight was an insane idea, so we stopped Jack before he jumped in.
半夜游過湖是個瘋狂的想法，所以我們在傑克跳下去之前攔住了他。
drive someone insane: The loud music from my neighbor's apartment every night is driving me insane, and I can't sleep at all.
鄰居家每晚傳來的大聲音樂快把我逼瘋了，我完全睡不著。
insane prices: The hotels near the concert hall charged insane prices, about five times the normal rate, on the night of the show.
演唱會當晚，音樂廳附近的飯店收取離譜的價格，大約是平常的五倍。
be declared insane: The man was declared insane by the court, so he was sent to a hospital instead of a prison.
這名男子被法院判定精神失常，所以被送往醫院而不是監獄。
